selected_evidence.requirement: Web service is persistent and active on TCP port 8081
selected_evidence.summary: The unit is enabled and active; before and after restart, netstat shows only 127.0.0.1:8081 listening and the health endpoint returns the expected content.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service is reachable through loopback but not through external interfaces
selected_evidence.summary: Both checks show a successful response through 127.0.0.1 and connection refusal through node1's external address 10.100.62.10.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 9ed9e820-6949-4971-a6a0-9fda0c2ea7ee; the restart was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 7b80e9c9-4b62-4722-97fb-8545da02beed; system state, service, listener, application checksum, loopback response, and external refusal were all verified after recovery.

commands.command:
sudo -n tee /usr/local/libexec/loopback-web-service.py >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_LOOPBACK_APP'
#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

BODY = "loopback-only web service healthy\n"

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "LoopbackWeb/1.0"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def reply(self, send_body):
        if self.path not in ("/", "/health"):
            body = "not found\n"
            self.send_response(404)
        else:
            body = BODY
            self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        if send_body:
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        self.reply(True)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.reply(False)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8081), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_LOOPBACK_APP

[Install]
